Read input: mg_06359_combined.v · Open raw
module mg_06359(clk, rst, en, mode, din, we, dout, re, status, full, empty);
input clk, rst; 
 input en; 
 input [1:0] mode; 
 input [19:0] din; 
 input we; 
 output [31:0] dout; 
 input re; 
 output [1:0] status; 
 output full; 
 output empty; 
 reg [31:0] mem[0:15]; 
 reg [31:0] dout; 
 reg [5:0] wp; 
 reg [4:0] rp; 
 wire [5:0] wp_p1; 
 reg [1:0] status; 
 reg [15:0] din_tmp1; 
 reg [31:0] din_tmp; 
 wire m16b; 
 reg full, empty; 
 assign m16b = (mode == 2'h0); 
 always @(posedge clk) 
  if(!en) wp <= #1 6'h0; 
  else 
  if(we) wp <= #1 wp_p1; 
 assign wp_p1 = m16b ? (wp + 6'h1) : (wp + 6'h2); 
 always @(posedge clk) 
  if(!en) rp <= #1 5'h0; 
  else 
  if(re) rp <= #1 rp + 5'h1; 
 always @(posedge clk) 
  status <= #1 ((rp[3:2] - wp[4:3]) - 2'h1); 
 always @(posedge clk) 
  empty <= #1 (wp[5:1] == rp[4:0]) & (m16b ? !wp[0] : 1'b0); 
 always @(posedge clk) 
  full <= #1 (wp[4:1] == rp[3:0]) & (wp[5] != rp[4]); 
 always @(posedge clk) 
  dout <= #1 mem[ rp[3:0] ]; 
 always @(posedge clk) 
  if(we & !wp[0]) din_tmp1 <= #1 din[19:4]; 
 always @(mode or din_tmp1 or din) 
  case(mode) 
  2'h0: din_tmp = {din[19:4], din_tmp1}; 
  2'h1: din_tmp = {14'h0, din[19:2]}; 
  2'h2: din_tmp = {11'h0, din[19:0]}; 
  endcase 
 always @(posedge clk) 
  if(we & (!m16b | (m16b & wp[0]) ) ) mem[ wp[4:1] ] <= #1 din_tmp; 
 endmodule
